name: Advanced Woo Ajax Search
author: Farid Mia

sections.description:
Most advanced woo ajax search plugin for WooCommerce. It provides a well-designed advanced AJAX search bar with real-time search suggestions to your users.

Advanced WooCommerce Search is a powerful AJAX-based live search plugin that enhances the default WooCommerce product search experience. It provides instant search suggestions, real-time results, and smart product matching to help customers find products faster without page reloads.

The plugin searches across product titles, descriptions, SKUs, IDs, categories, tags, brands, and more. It also includes advanced filters, multiple search result layouts, customizable display options, and smart search features such as fuzzy search and typo correction.

With support for shortcodes, Elementor, and Gutenberg, you can easily place the search bar anywhere on your store. Built for speed and performance, Advanced WooCommerce Search improves product discovery, enhances the shopping experience, and helps increase conversions.
.

Features

  • Lightning Fast AJAX Search: Instant search results with real-time autocomplete.
  • Smart Search Engine: Exact, fuzzy, and advanced search logic for better accuracy.
  • Search Everywhere: Search by title, content, SKU, ID, categories, tags, brands, and more.
  • Smart Suggestions: “Did you mean?”, recent searches, and trending search suggestions.
  • Advanced Filters: Filter results by price, stock, sale status, visibility, and more.
  • Multiple Layouts: Choose from Dropdown, Cards, Compact, Amazon Style, and more.
  • Fully Customizable: Show or hide images, prices, SKUs, badges, and add-to-cart buttons.
  • Search Analytics: Track customer searches, CTR, and no-result keywords.
  • Performance Optimized: Fast indexing, caching, and background processing for large stores.
  • Advanced Features: Synonyms, stop words, and WPML/Polylang compatibility.
  • Easy Integration: Replace WooCommerce search or use shortcode, Elementor, and Gutenberg.
  • Import & Export: Backup and restore search settings with one click.

Using the Shortcode

Easily add the search bar to any page, post, or widget by using the following shortcode:

[awas_search]

Simply copy and paste the shortcode into your desired location.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload advanced-woo-ajax-search.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Place <?php do_action('plugin_name_hook'); ?> in your templates
